messages:
Sarah (CSM): Quick follow-up on QuantumHealth — saw three 503 spikes last week and another cluster this morning. Customer is asking for root cause and short-term mitigation. any owners?

IncidentBot: Detected 5xx spike on qhealth-prod. Incident created: https://incident.redwood.example/INC-2026-231. Alert: 503 rate 8% > threshold.

Oliver (Support): I saw the CS ticket. Customer reported timeouts around 09:12 PST. I attached their logs. We're suggested to prioritize a hotfix. cc @Kevin

Kevin (SRE): I'll take lead on the RCA. First look shows request queue backed up on model-serving node pool (gpu-2). Could be KV cache evictions + batching regression.

Maria (CSM): Thanks @Kevin. Action items: 1) Temporary traffic reroute to fallback variant 2) Roll restart problematic nodes 3) Postmortem + customer-facing summary. Who can own 1 and 2?

Kevin (SRE): I can do 1 and 2. Plan: start routing 20% to fallback now, escalate to 50% if errors persist. I'll run the rollout and monitor.

AJ (DevOps): For routing we can use the routing policy API. Quick snippet:

``
POST /v1/routing/policy
{
  "service": "qhealth-prod",
  "rule": { "fallback_percentage": 20, "variant": "qhealth-v1-fallback" }
}
```

Or run `rctl route set qhealth-prod --fallback 20%`

Oliver (Support): Drafted the customer note for initial heads-up. Short message + mitigation plan. Leaving it in the CS draft folder: https://drive.redwood.example/qhealth/initial-note.md

Sarah (CSM): Good. Please add ETA for full fix and a runbook entry so this doesn't repeat. Also flag any billing/spend impact.

Kevin (SRE): Update — routed 20% at 09:45 PST. Error rate down to 2.1% on qhealth-prod. Kicking off rolling restart for 3 nodes now. I'll post logs in the incident thread.

Oliver (Support): Noted, updated customer draft with the 09:45 mitigation. Awaiting postmortem before sharing deeper details. :thumbsup:

Maria (CSM): Postmortem owner? @Kevin will draft, can someone QA the customer note? @Oliver?

Kevin (SRE): I'll draft the postmortem by EOD today (1800456912). Will include timelines, root cause hypothesis (cache pressure + recent batching tweak), and recommended config guardrails.

Oliver (Support): I'll QA the note and send to the customer tomorrow morning. Adding a follow-up call if they want.

Sarah (CSM): Thanks team — please update the incident tracker and close action items when done. I'll sync with account exec on renewal risk if this repeats. Sarah out.
